skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 40% ATK (+3) damage to a single target in 3 hit combos. After acting, randomly puts one ally into the [Berserk] state (deals 30% more damage when attacking).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 26% ATK (+2) damage to each enemy in the entire row in 5 hit combos, and inflicts [Panic] on the enemy (seals the enemy's energy for several turns; when the same effect is present, the highest value takes effect).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 33% ATK (+2) damage to each enemy in the entire row in 5 hit combos, and inflicts [Panic] on the enemy (seals the enemy's energy for several turns; when the same effect is present, the highest value takes effect).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. After each action, drains the sealed energy from the main target (can only drain once per turn; after a successful drain, cannot inflict [Panic] on enemies again that turn). For each point of energy drained, deals 40% ATK extra damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. After each action, drains the sealed energy from the main target (can only drain once per turn; after a successful drain, cannot inflict [Panic] on enemies again that turn). For each point of energy drained, deals 50% ATK extra damage to all enemies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own max HP by. After each action, drains the sealed energy from the main target (can only drain once per turn; after a successful drain, cannot inflict [Panic] on enemies again that turn). For each point of energy drained, deals 55% ATK extra damage to all enemies.
